title: red_headed_league
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Sherlock Holmes investigates the bizarre case of a pawnbroker hired by a mysterious "Red-Headed League" to copy the encyclopedia, and deduces that the scheme is a ruse to keep him away from his shop while his assistant, the notorious criminal John Clay, tunnels from the cellar into an adjoining bank vault; Holmes and the police foil the robbery.
